title: nonfe gorilla melee (Equip dagger)
features:
changes dagger to gorilla melee

you can edit the script with 

mesh id and texture id

made by nemo i think
script:
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Viewmodels["v_Dagger"].Part.MeshId = "rbxassetid://5390501239" -- put rbx mesh id
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Viewmodels["v_Dagger"].Part.TextureID = "rbxassetid://5390501421" -- put rbx texture id
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Viewmodels["v_Dagger"].Part.Transparency = 0
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Viewmodels["v_Dagger"].Handle.Transparency = 1
